text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: Did you get proper rest yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I was just lounging around, listening
to a trendy CD I borrowed from Maruzensky."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't really follow trends, but that was definitely a great song.
I can totally see why everyone loves it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether that song was actually trending remains questionable.
—Regardless, Mr. C.B. seemed to get some proper rest.
